title: ID0417282-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / R4 170001744] ColdStartPLC_KF10
description:
Reported issue:  We are currently experiencing recurring issues with one of our charging stations. Charging sessions do not consistently start, and we are seeing a high number of errors being logged. Key details: ChargePointStatus: Faulted ConnectivityStatus: Online ErrorCode: OtherError VendorErrorCode: SafetyRelay_QA26 The issue occurs intermittently, with frequent transitions between Available, Unavailable, and Faulted states. Sample error timestamps: 07/04/2025 @ 09:11:39 → Faulted 07/04/2025 @ 09:09:58 → Faulted 07/04/2025 @ 03:01:42 → Unavailable (Error) And many more similar entries throughout the day. Due to these frequent faults, the charger is unreliable and not functioning as expected.
Solution:
yyyy-mm-dd:
